Upload a large file successfully

```go title="Go"
package main

import (
	"fmt"
	pkg "github.com/xberg-io/liter-llm/packages/go/v2"
)

func ptr[T any](value T) *T { return &value }
func main() {
	req := pkg.CreateFileRequest{
		File:     `eyJwcm9tcHQiOiAibGFyZ2UgdHJhaW5pbmcgZGF0YSJ9Cg==`,
		Purpose:  pkg.FilePurposeFineTune,
		Filename: ptr(`large_training_data.jsonl`),
	}
	client, clientErr := pkg.CreateClient("your-api-key", nil, nil, nil, nil)
	if clientErr != nil {
		panic(clientErr)
	}
	defer client.Free()
	result, err := client.CreateFile(req)
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	fmt.Printf("%+v\n", result.ID)
}
```
